text:
Maya (Finance): spotting a discrepancy on acct: NOVA-LLC Feb invoice. Invoice shows 642,300 embedding units billed but the usage dashboard is ~423k. any recent backfills?
Jon (Billing): I see the ledger line for embeds. No manual credits logged. Can you paste invoice line?
Maya (Finance): invoice line: `2026-02|embeddings|642300|$3211.50` dashboard panel (aggregated): 423,178 embed units.
Priya (Data Eng): we ran a replay on 2026-03-02 (`usage-replay-2026-03-02`) to pick up delayed events from a flaky S3 source. It had dedupe logic but I remember a bug with null `request_id` for old SDK.
Omar (Platform): @Priya if replay recreated new uuids for missing request_id, duplicates can get into processed table and billing. meter writer uses request_id when present.
metering-bot: replay job completed: id=usage-replay-2026-03-02 processed=2,104,881 events.
Priya (Data Eng): quick check: counting unique coalesce(request_id, message_id) for NOVA-LLC in Feb returns ~423k. raw processed count matches invoice ~642k before dedupe.
Jon (Billing): that suggests duplicates added by replay. can we produce a deduped recount and a delta in billable units/cost?
Priya (Data Eng): running dedupe recount now: `select sum(billable_units) from (select coalesce(request_id, message_id) as k, max(billable_units) as billable_units from usage_processed where org='nova_llc' and month='2026-02' group by k) t;`
Priya (Data Eng): recount result: 423,172 deduped embed units. delta = 219,128 units (~$1,095 at list).
Maya (Finance): provisional approval to issue credit up to $1,200 pending legal/CS review. please prepare credit memo draft and ledger entries.
Jon (Billing): creating credit memo CM-2026-0467 for $1,096.40 tentatively. Will hold posting until legal OK.
Omar (Platform): action: add stronger dedupe key to metering writer and make replay preserve original message_id when present. filing infra ticket INF-2380.
Priya (Data Eng): also will run a 30-day retrospective scan to surface other orgs affected; meter-bot flagged potential dupes earlier.
metering-bot: replay audit: 9 orgs with suspect duplicates totaling ~820k suspect embed units (detection only).
Maya (Finance): thanks. Jon, loop in CS for customer note and let me review final wording. Leaving thread open until customer notified. :email:
Jon (Billing): will send draft to CS + Maya by EOD. :thumbsup:
